description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseService class in the OrangeHRM project, which manages employee license data by interacting with the EmployeeLicenseDao. It includes getter and setter methods for the DAO instance, facilitating dependency management.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to access and modify employee license data via the EmployeeLicenseDao.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicenseDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeLicenseDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeLicenseDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeLicenseDao instance, allowing dependency injection.
